title: A Summer for the Bakery
author: Kestrel Eastwick
blurb: Lior Fairweather, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
